caption: The drawing depicts a carved figure of a standing person on a rectangular pedestal. The figure has brown skin and black hair, and is wearing a large feathered headdress in tan and yellow colors. The figure is dressed in a red and tan garment with green accents, has a skirt-like lower garment in green, and is barefoot. The figure is holding a bundle of cigars labeled "TOBACCO" in one hand and a small basket filled with what appears to be tobacco leaves in the other hand. The pedestal is light yellow with black edges, and has the word "CIGARS" written in large black letters on the front. On the side of the pedestal, the words "Cigars and Games" are written, with a small illustration of an open box and cigars. The background of the image is plain and unornamented.
title: Cigar Store Indian
